summary: Backend-only. Validated enhanced POST /api/sgp/super-admin/debug-consultacliente/{company_id} and regressed GET/PUT /api/sgp/config + generic proxy /api/sgp/{action}. 9/9 pytest tests passed against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Debug endpoint correctly requires super-admin, sanitizes CPF to digits-only, accepts _app/_token/_base_url overrides (stripped from forwarded body), masks token in debug_request.body_sent (first4...last4), emits diagnostic_hint when SGP returns empty contratos/clientes, and returns full cfg_snapshot showing stored vs. used values. Generic proxy /api/sgp/{action} still requires auth and rejects unknown actions.

coverage_areas: GET /api/sgp/config regression — returns company_id/base_url/app/enabled, no raw token
PUT /api/sgp/config regression — saves and persists, GET returns token_masked
Same endpoint with regular company user token → 401/403 (require_super_admin enforced)

Basic super-admin call with cpfcnpj '034.590.825-26' returns 200, url=<base>/api/ura/consultacliente/, data present, diagnostic_hint populated (SGP returned empty via httpbin 404), debug_request.body_sent has cpfcnpj digits-only '03459082526' + masked token 'abcd...qrst', cfg_snapshot has base_url/app_stored/app_used/base_url_used/enabled

Override via params: _app='nexonet', _token='OVERRIDE-tok-9999-zzzz', _base_url='https://httpbin.org' — underscore keys stripped from body_sent, body_sent.app==override, body_sent.token masked with override prefix/suffix, cfg_snapshot.app_stored unchanged==8ip, cfg_snapshot.app_used==nexonet, base_url_used reflects override
Generic proxy accessible with company user auth (200/400/502 depending on config state)

critical_code_review_comments: sgp_debug_consultacliente is well-scoped: require_super_admin, params.pop for underscore overrides prevents leaking to SGP, CPF sanitization only on cpfcnpj/cpf/cnpj keys, token masking uses first4...last4 (>=8 chars) with safe fallback '***' otherwise.
cfg_snapshot correctly distinguishes app_stored vs app_used and base_url vs base_url_used — this is exactly what the operator needs to see whether override took effect. Good.

diagnostic_hint only appears when payload is a dict with empty contratos AND empty clientes; if SGP returns non-JSON (e.g., httpbin 404 HTML → data.raw), payload is still a dict {'raw': ...} so hint fires. Confirmed working.

Minor: sgp_debug_consultacliente does NOT validate base_url_override / token_override the way PUT /config does (no Cyrillic/URL-shape check). Acceptable since it's a super-admin diagnostic tool, but worth noting.

Minor: sgp_debug_fatura2via (line 483) does NOT have the same _app/_token/_base_url override support — inconsistent with the new consultacliente behavior. If the debugging story extends to fatura2via, main agent may want to mirror the enhancement.
